pre_master.name: Prismatic Evolutions
pre_master.desc: Our 3×3 master binder — main cards in number order, then Reverse Holo, Poke Ball, and Master Ball at the back.
pre_master.rule: The first pages are the main cards, in number order from 001 to 180, with no gaps. After that come the other versions, each in their own section: Reverse Holo, then Poke Ball, then Master Ball, all in number order. Each section starts on a new page, so a few pockets at the end of a section stay empty.

dlr_master.name: Delta Reign
dlr_master.desc: Our 3×3 master binder — main cards in number order, then Reverse Holos at the back.
dlr_master.rule: The first pages are the main cards, in number order from 001 to 141, including secret rares, with no gaps. After that come the Reverse Holo versions, in number order, starting on a new page. A few pockets at the end of a section stay empty. This set has no Poke Ball or Master Ball versions.

pbl_master.name: Pitch Black
pbl_master.desc: Our 3×3 master binder — main cards in number order, then Reverse Holos at the back.
pbl_master.rule: The first pages are the main cards, in number order from 001 to 120, including secret rares, with no gaps. After that come the Reverse Holo versions, in number order, starting on a new page. A few pockets at the end of a section stay empty. This set has no Poke Ball or Master Ball versions.
